source.recommendation: Semantically viable for the parcel gateway, subject to written confirmation of WFS layer reuse terms.
source.publisher: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Santiago de Cali (IDESC), Alcaldía de Santiago de Cali
source.operatorAttribution: WFS identifies feature type catastro:cat_bas_terrenos, title ‘Catastro: Terrenos’, abstract ‘Fuente de información: Subdirección de Catastro’. IDESC GetCapabilities provider name is the Cali spatial data infrastructure.
source.protocol: WFS 2.0.0 GetFeature; outputFormat application/json (GeoJSON); bbox and srsName in CRS:84/EPSG:4326 work in the already observed sample.
source.scope: Cali municipal/district cadastral layer. WFS feature-type bounds: lon -76.61663 to -76.46002, lat 3.29667 to 3.54755.
source.semantics: Cadastral terrain polygons (‘Terrenos’) maintained by the Subdirección de Catastro, with parcel relation fields and cadastral identifiers. This is cadastral mapping, not a land-registry title certificate or a surveyed legal boundary. The linked open-data catalog describes the related historical property table as records identified by NPN and id_predio in the cadastral base, with terrain/construction areas, appraisal and economic use by year.

identifier.observedType: string, 30 digits in existing bounded sample
identifier.alternate: id_predio; values observed as integers in the sample but DescribeFeatureType declares xsd:decimal
identifier.sampleStats: Existing sample has 3 rows with both identifiers populated; no full-box/global duplicate or null audit was done in this assessment.
identifier.nativeLookup: WFS GetFeature filter on npn or id_predio; validate exact filter syntax, uniqueness and null rates before relying on it for gateway lookup.
identifier.wfsFeatureId: Existing sample feature IDs are GeoServer row IDs (cat_bas_terrenos.<internal id>), so retain npn as intended durable key rather than exposing service FIDs.

boundedQueryEvidence.existingResponse: 3 MultiPolygon features returned; WFS reports numberMatched=118 in the box; page with WFS 2.0 startIndex/count. Root independently confirmed equivalent GeoJSON response and page availability.
boundedQueryEvidence.currentNetworkProbe: GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200, 503,793 XML bytes; DescribeFeatureType returned HTTP 200, 5,114 XML bytes. No second GetFeature query or broad export was made for this review.

termsAndAttribution.exactWfsLayerLicense: Unresolved. WFS GetCapabilities reports Fees NONE and AccessConstraints NONE, which are not a reuse license. The IDESC website terms PDF says its content/information cannot be commercialized or exploited; that is a restrictive web/service term and should be treated as applying unless the city clarifies otherwise.
termsAndAttribution.relatedOpenDataLicense: Datos Abiertos Cali lists ‘Información Histórica de Predios de Santiago de Cali’ (annual CSV table) under Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike. Its page was last updated 2026-03-19 and describes NPN/id_predio fields. This is related tabular data; it does not establish that the separate IDESC WFS geometry layer is licensed CC BY-SA.
termsAndAttribution.recommendedAttributionIfAuthorized: Fuente: Subdirección de Catastro, Alcaldía de Santiago de Cali; servicio WFS IDESC (catastro:cat_bas_terrenos). Indicate adaptation to WGS84. Apply CC BY-SA only if the city confirms it covers these WFS geometries; otherwise honor the IDESC terms and do not use commercially pending clarification.

remainingChecks: Ask IDESC/Subdirección de Catastro to confirm terms for this specific geometry type, commercial reuse, redistribution, and attribution; reconcile IDESC website prohibition with the catalog’s CC BY-SA entry for the separate CSV dataset.
